decision: D115 §一.4 and §三 — the JavaScript the CLI injects into a test page is real source that the JavaScript parser checks, not a template literal nothing can lint.

constants.name: VELAR_BROWSER_PERFORMANCE_RUNTIME
documentation: * The page-side runtime `velar test --browser` installs before a page loads.
* It captures the descriptors a measurement needs — `performance`, `document`,
* intrinsics around them — before the application under test can replace any of
* and `cancel` on one registry key. It runs in the page, never in the test
* process, so it is injected as text rather than imported.
